Author: CrownedPandaXIV
Name: XIV Fleet Companion
Description:
Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try!

Subs and their routes, supplies, parts, retainers, Free Companies, inventories, income, the market and trends, all in the game. Keep your fleet on this PC with nothing else to install, or share it between PCs (and with the free Windows app) through a database. Type /xivfleet to start.

Needs:
• AutoRetainer (from https://love.puni.sh/ment.json)

Works best with:
• Allagan Tools: bags, retainers' items and FC chests
• FC Tracker (from https://puni.sh/api/repository/erdelf): FC houses
• Submarine Tracker: voyage loot

Thanks to kawaii, NightmareXIV and the Puni.sh team (AutoRetainer), Critical_Impact (Allagan Tools), erdelf (FC Tracker) and Infi (Submarine Tracker) for their plugins.
Punchline: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Changelog:
### New
- Sub Calculator data, daily: newer loot and breakpoint data (XIVStats, Pepper's guide) is now checked every day and published once it passes the checks. The plugin downloads it once a day, or when the game next opens after a day missed, and uses it when it's newer than the copy it came with, so a patch's new data no longer waits for a plugin update. Nothing changes when it can't be reached.
- Subs → Repair in: how many more voyages each sub can go on its current route before a part needs repairing, from the last workshop reading of its parts. "Repair now" in red, 1 voyage in amber; the part and its condition on hover.

### Changed
- Experience with a bonus is now in whole points per sector, as the game gives it (Voyage Planner, Route Finder, Compare Builds, Levelling Plan).
- Levelling Plan works out its stage rows once per plan, not every frame.
